effects.printed_clause: When opponent activates a card/effect or declares an attack: destroy that card, then optionally destroy an opponent Attack Position monster; only 1 activation per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Separate EVENT_CHAINING and EVENT_ATTACK_ANNOUNCE activation effects share the oath count. Each destroys the chain handler/event group or attacker first and only after a successful destruction optionally selects and destroys an Attack Position opponent monster.

official_references.matched_structure: Attack-announcement Trap activation and attacker destruction.
EVENT_CHAINING operation that uses Duel.Destroy(eg) after relation/chain checks.

coverage_override.reason: The card/effect-activation and attack-announcement cases are alternate activation events for one Trap effect; destruction, optional follow-up destruction, and the activation HOPT are all represented in record 1.
